name: Benicia SRA
description: Benicia State Recreation Area along the Carquinez Strait offers marshland, bay views, trails, and fishing, including the popular Dillon Point area.
fullDescription: Benicia State Recreation Area along the Carquinez Strait offers marshland, bay views, trails, and fishing, including the popular Dillon Point area.
whatTheyOffer:
- Walking and biking trails with views of the Carquinez Strait
- Fishing, especially in the marshland at Dillon Point
- Picnicking and wildlife viewing
- Three first-come en route campsites for fully self-contained RVs/trailers only (no tents)
- Some temporary area closures possible during the Glen Cove Waterfront Enhancement Project
- Open daily 8 am to sunset; phone (707) 648-1911
howToGetIt:
**Fees:**
- Day use: $6 per vehicle

**Save with park passes:** Benicia SRA accepts the California Explorer, Golden Poppy, Distinguished Veteran, Golden Bear, and Senior Golden Bear passes, plus the California State Library Parks Pass (free to check out at public libraries).
